notes: Reliable uploads: laps are gzipped before upload (4x smaller, no more lost race laps), upload timeout scales with lap length (Nordschleife-ready), pending uploads are visible on the dashboard, hosted-event stage changes no longer create ghost sessions, and each stage tracks its own best lap.
notas: Uploads confiáveis: as voltas sobem gzipadas (4x menores, sem voltas de corrida perdidas), o timeout de upload escala com o tamanho da volta (pronto pra Nordschleife), uploads pendentes aparecem no dashboard, trocas de etapa em evento hosted não criam mais sessões-fantasma, e cada etapa registra o próprio best lap.
